name: Dead and Gone gives Bolt and Dash an additional use (#2714)
contract: Bolt and Dash 520670 has ProcCharges 1 and two spell mods (damage and cooldown, class mask word1 0x800 = Heartseeking Bolt) in the client Spell.dbc (2026-09-17); its text says the Bolt consumes it and Dash 524602 follows. Dead and Gone 705524 effect 0 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER SPELLMOD_CHARGES with base 0 (+1) on class mask word0 0x01000000, the flags of 520670, and its text reads 'Your Bolt and Dash now affects an additional use of a Heartseeking Bolt'. Aura::CalcMaxCharges is the DBC charge plus that flat mod, so the buff has 1 charge without the talent and 2 with it, and the native Player::RemoveSpellMods drops one per matching cast. The module used to force ProcCharges to 0 and remove the buff after every Heartseeking Bolt, so the talent never delivered the second use. Asserted: 1 charge and one use without the talent, 2 charges with it, the buff still present after the first Bolt and Dash granted only after the second. The second Bolt only succeeds if the buff's -101% cooldown mod was applied to the first (Bolt category cooldown 10000 ms).

steps.label: Let the weapon swap cooldown expire
Dead and Gone is not known yet
Bolt and Dash without Dead and Gone
Bolt and Dash keeps its DBC charge (ProcCharges 1)
Bolt and Dash with Dead and Gone
Dead and Gone adds one charge to the DBC charge
Bolt and Dash survives the first Bolt with one charge
Second Heartseeking Bolt (needs Bolt and Dash's no-cooldown mod, the first Bolt's 10 s cooldown is still running otherwise)
The second use spends the last charge
